Description: Subject identifier within one study (unique per participant); useful when aligning with antibody raw data.
Sample source (e.g., whole blood, PBMC, nasal swab).
Gene expression platform used (e.g., RNA-seq, microarray, scRNA-seq).
Technical or experimental batch ID within one study
Infection status grouping (e.g., infected vs. uninfected); represents the outcome in inoculation studies.
Symptom severity group (e.g., symptomatic vs. asymptomatic); represents the outcome in inoculation studies.
Original symptom classification from source study.
Disease Severity Score (quantitative summary of symptoms).
Indicator of vaccine response (e.g., responder, moderate responder, or non-responder), defined based on Maximum Fold Change (MFC).
Group assignment within a study (e.g., vaccine arm, control).
Year when participant enrolled in the study.
Alternate experimental sample accession in ImmPort
Race as recorded in metadata (e.g., White, Asian, Black).
Indicator for sham or placebo treatment.
Symptom group classification for previously infected individuals.
Presence of underlying or chronic medical conditions.

Indicator of whether the RNA sample was treated with TurboDNase (Thermo Fisher Scientific) to remove contaminating genomic DNA during RNA extraction. Marked as “Turbo Treated” if DNase treatment was applied.
Medications taken by participant during study.
Days since COVID-19 diagnosis at time of sampling.
Whether vaccinated in the prior three influenza seasons (Yes/No).
Number of influenza vaccinations received in the previous 10 years.
Binary or quantitative measure of antibody seroconversion.
Presence or level of viral shedding post-infection or vaccination.
